variants.title: Quảng trường rộng
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished 16:9 landscape screenshot mockup of an original Vietnamese fantasy web RPG beginner village, Trúc Khê, Nam Lĩnh. Reference image 1 is approved Bright Handheld ART STYLE ONLY: same clean hard pixel clusters, dark outlines, mint/bright grass, vermilion roofs, cyan water, top-down orthographic three-quarter handheld RPG view. Reference image 2 is old village: retain type of world but RADICALLY REDUCE all building size and object coverage, NOT its cramped composition. Camera much farther out, original small chibi characters, two male blue/green and two female red/purple identity designs matching reference, primary player blue in center. At a conceptual 1920x1080 viewport player 36-44px tall, small houses 140-200px wide, major paths 120-160px wide, visible ground/grass 60-70% of scene. Five or six small houses total. Trees/props small. Absolutely no huge hero portraits or advertising. Paths remain open. Tiny scholar, healer, blacksmith NPCs before homes and two villagers walking. Hint life with smoke from forge, tiny fluttering leaves, water ripples and tiny butterfly. Crisp readable illustration at high native resolution, do not blur. Simple identical small translucent dark-jade HTML-like HUD in every version: top-left character card only text "Vân Sinh" and "Cấp 1"; top-center "Trúc Khê · Nam Lĩnh"; small upper-right quest panel "Làm quen Trúc Khê" then "Gặp thầy đồ, dược sư, thợ rèn"; small bottom-right text buttons "Túi đồ", "Nhiệm vụ", "Nhân vật". All text in Vietnamese with correct accents, no Han/Kana/Hangul characters, no lettering baked onto buildings. No text anywhere else. Clear west forest exit, east mountain exit, upper road to future region. No franchise characters or logos. Same HUD and scale across variants. This is a layout preview, no border, no montage.
Distinct composition: A broad central grassy and sandy village square, tiny well slightly below center, school upper left of center leaving north road clear, healer west, forge east, three small homes along bottom. Straight west/east road with an unobstructed central north branch. Most compact, immediately readable wayfinding.
